ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_loss_clipped_norm
ir.intuition: Inject an explicit clipping constraint on the normalized advantage gap to prevent extreme scaling effects on the logits difference. This stabilizes training by bounding the influence of very large advantage gaps, while preserving normalization and scale invariance.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
norm_factor = max(norm(advantage_gap, ord=2), epsilon)
clipped_adv = clamp(advantage_gap, -clip_val, clip_val)
norm_factor_clipped = max(norm(clipped_adv, ord=2), epsilon)
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_diff = (diff / norm_factor_clipped) * scale + shift
loss = -logsigmoid(scaled_diff)
if weight:
  loss *= weight
return sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))
    shift = float(extra.get('shift', 0.1))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', 5.0))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    clipped_adv = ops.clamp(advantage_gap, -clip_val, clip_val)
    norm_factor = ops.max(ops.norm(clipped_adv, ord=2), epsilon)
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_diff = ops.add(ops.mul(ops.div(diff, norm_factor), scale), shift)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
